summary: Mint Incorporation Limited furnished a Form 6-K on September 15, 2026, attaching a press release announcing that its indirect majority-owned subsidiary Rice AI Holding Limited signed a licensing agreement with Pudgy Penguins, Inc. to develop and sell a co-branded limited-edition AI companion robot, the Blue Pengu Minibot. The license is non-exclusive and worldwide; Rice AI bears production, marketing, compliance, warranty and after-sales costs and will sell through its own e-commerce and retail channels. No financial terms, equity stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation or closing date are disclosed. This is an ordinary commercial/product announcement, not a special situation; no deal terms to arbitrage.
